# Mattia Astori

> Mattia Astori is a technology investor and founder of Astori Ventures, backing companies from early stage through growth. He is also a co-creator of Sacratos, a documentary project.

## Investing

Mattia founded Astori Ventures, a private investment firm. His work spans early-stage and growth investments in private technology companies. Across his investment work, Mattia reports $70M in investments and 322 investments. This total includes work before Astori Ventures and should not be read as Astori Ventures-only performance.

- Astori Ventures: https://astori.vc/
- Personal biography: https://mattiaastori.com/about
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mattiaastori
- FINRA registration record for Mattia Astori (CRD 8099738): https://files.brokercheck.finra.org/individual/individual_8099738.pdf

## Documentary project

Mattia is a co-creator of Sacratos, a documentary project. This is a separate creative project, not his investing occupation.

- Sacratos: https://sacratos.com/

## Contact

For investment-related inquiries: mattia@astori.vc.
